description: This file contains CMake macros and functions related to build configuration and package management. It includes functions for handling target link libraries, compile options, include directories, and generating installation scripts for CMake package configuration files. The content indicates it is a set of helper functions intended for use within a CMake-based build system.

methods.name: add_element
methods.description: Appends an element to a specified list variable.

methods.name: _get_default_link_name
methods.description: Determines the default link name and directory for a given library path.

methods.name: get_if_link_libraries
methods.description: Retrieves the link libraries and directories for a specified target, resolving interface dependencies recursively.

methods.name: get_if_compile_defines
methods.description: Gathers compile definitions for a target, including interface definitions and dependencies.

methods.name: get_if_compile_options
methods.description: Collects compile options for a target and its dependencies.

methods.name: get_if_include_dirs
methods.description: Retrieves include directories for a target, resolving nested interface includes.

methods.name: InstallCMakeConfig
methods.description: Generates and installs a CMake package configuration file for a target, supporting dependency inclusion.

methods.name: InstallPackageConfig
methods.description: Creates and installs a pkg-config (.pc) file for a target, including compile options, defines, and include directories.

methods.name: InstallFindModule
methods.description: Installs CMake find modules (*.cmake) from a specified directory, optionally recursing.

methods.name: print_properties
methods.description: Prints all CMake property list entries.

methods.name: print_target_properties
methods.description: Displays all properties of a specified target.

methods.name: semicolon_safe_string
methods.description: Replaces semicolons in a string with a non-printable character for safe handling.

methods.name: InstallCompatibleCMakeConfig
methods.description: Creates a compatible CMake interface target with specified public headers and dependencies, suitable for legacy systems.
